title: A Beautiful Chemistry
subtitle: The Friendship That Became Everything
quote: The strongest relationships are not built in a day. They are built through countless little moments that slowly become unforgettable memories.
endQuote: Some people don't change your life through grand gestures. They change it through ordinary days that slowly become your favorite memories. Grace had become that person for me.

content.text: Grace returned to campus after her trip, and somehow, everything felt complete again.
The trees still swayed with the evening breeze.
Everything felt brighter because she was back.
From that day onwards, our friendship grew stronger with every passing day.
It wasn't because of one big moment.
It was because of hundreds of small moments.
Every morning started with a simple message.
And almost every night ended with,
Those messages slowly became a routine.
A routine I never wanted to lose.
We started spending more time together on campus.
We simply found ourselves walking together.
There were days when we discussed academics for hours.
Other days, we laughed over the smallest and silliest things.
Sometimes she would tell me stories from her childhood.
Sometimes I would share embarrassing incidents from mine.
Not because the joke was funny.
But because seeing her happy somehow made me happy.
Moments when she would get angry over something I said.
Sometimes she would stop replying to my messages.
I was always the first person to text.

content.speaker: Grace
content.text: Hari... why can't you stay without talking to me?
One evening, we were sitting together after class.
The sun was slowly setting behind the university buildings.
Students walked past us, laughing with their friends.
Grace suddenly looked at me and asked,

content.speaker: Grace
content.text: Hari... why do you always help everyone?

content.speaker: Hari
content.text: Because someone helped me when I needed it.
But because they came from her.
I was the first person she called.
The same was true for me.
If I had a bad day...
Talking to Grace somehow made everything better.
But she had become my safe place.
One day, while walking across campus, I suddenly realized something.
I no longer looked forward to weekends.
I no longer counted the holidays.
I looked forward to seeing Grace every single day.
I still didn't know what this relationship was.
Life had become much more beautiful after she entered it.
